Definition: severed, i.e. harvest (as reaped), the crop, the time, the reaper, or figuratively; also a limb (of a tree, or simply foliage)
BiblicalUsage: 1) harvest, harvesting; 1a) process of harvesting; 1b) crop, what is harvested or reaped; 1c) time of harvest; 2) boughs, branches
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
